findings.reason: Instance of the TSC module which implements a hardware Trojan trigger and power-based side-channel payload.
Trojan trigger signal that activates when a 128-bit counter reaches its maximum value.
A 128-bit counter that increments on changes of the AES output, used to trigger the Trojan after an extremely rare number of operations.
A 128-bit register that acts as a Trojan payload, rotating its bits to cause power leakage when triggered.
